elements.label: Ebrehel, the Ragged Sword
elements.description: Scarsword, Gatemaker, Orphan; Lake-Gift and Godsickle and Deserter. It has known many hands, and yet it was never wielded for the purpose it was intended. Perhaps that is why it wanders from warrior to warrior: in the hope that one will remember why its blade was forged so keenly. [Kill Von Helling to get the sword. This counts as 3 Foe Resolution.]

elements.label: Whispers on Wings
elements.description: The chatter of the birds around the lake-grove might lead us to the keeper of the Ragged Sword. We need to consolidate more wing-rumour and flock-chatter before a path presents itself.
